existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: `ChargeItemDefinition` appears to have been removed from the R6 core package. Existing R4 instances, canonical references, generated classes, and resource-specific APIs need explicit migration handling; the main uncertainty is whether HL7 intends a specific replacement path not visible in the local computable package.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration is primarily an artifact-retirement problem. Systems should inventory persisted `ChargeItemDefinition` instances and canonical references, decide whether to preserve them in an R4 island/custom profile, or map selected business content into R6 resources such as `Invoice`, `DeviceDefinition`, and `MonetaryComponent`. Applicability expressions, canonical lifecycle metadata, and reusable property groups do not have an obvious lossless R6 target.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high that the R6 package lacks `ChargeItemDefinition`: the assigned file is absent, the R6 index contains no matching entry, and exact package search found no references. Confidence is medium for replacement analysis because local package artifacts do not include official ballot narrative, Jira rationale, or cross-version maps.
